title: První den ve škole
desc: Tomík se ve velké škole ztratí. Robot Bip mu ukáže cestu — a Tomík najde kamarádku.
desc_en: Tommy gets lost in the big school. Bip the robot shows him the way, and Tommy finds a friend.
world: a bright friendly primary school with big windows, a colorful classroom, a long hallway with lockers, a sunny schoolyard with trees
setting: Světlá přátelská základní škola: velká okna, barevná třída, dlouhá chodba se skříňkami a slunný dvůr se stromy.
music: cheerful gentle children's music, piano and xylophone, light bouncy rhythm, hopeful and friendly, instrumental, 100 bpm

tom.name: Tomík
tom.desc: a small shy 6-year-old boy with messy brown hair and round glasses, wearing a green hoodie, blue shorts and a huge orange backpack
tom.look: Malý nesmělý šestiletý kluk s rozcuchanými hnědými vlasy a kulatými brýlemi, v zelené mikině, modrých kraťasech a s obrovským oranžovým batohem.

bip.name: robot Bip
bip.desc: a friendly small round white robot with a blue screen face showing two dot eyes, short stubby arms, a single wheel and a little antenna with a red light
bip.look: Malý kulatý bílý robot s modrou obrazovkou místo obličeje, krátkými ručkami, jedním kolečkem a anténkou s červeným světýlkem.

shots.action: Ráno před velkou školní bránou. Tomík se dívá nahoru na budovu, polkne a sevře popruhy batohu.
shots.keyframe: Tommy stands in front of a big school gate in the morning, holding the straps of his huge orange backpack
shots.motion: Tommy looks up at the big school, swallows, and holds his backpack straps tighter
shots.narration: Tomík měl dnes první den ve škole.
shots.narration_en: Today was Tommy's first day at school.

shots.action: Tomík pomalu vejde do dlouhé chodby s mnoha dveřmi, rozhlédne se a zastaví se.
shots.keyframe: Tommy walks into a long school hallway with many doors, looking lost
shots.motion: Tommy walks slowly into the hallway, looks left, then right, then stops
shots.narration: Chodba byla dlouhá a dveří tolik!
shots.narration_en: The hallway was long, with so many doors!

shots.action: Tomík stojí uprostřed chodby a otáčí se ke všem dveřím, oči má čím dál větší. Chytí se popruhů a rty se mu zachvějí.
shots.keyframe: Tommy stands alone in the middle of the hallway, looking worried and biting his lip
motion: Tommy turns around slowly, looking at all the doors, his eyes getting big
Tommy hugs his backpack straps, his lip trembles, then he stands still
shots.narration: Kam mám jít? Tomík se bál, že se ztratil.
shots.narration_en: Where do I go? Tommy was afraid he was lost.

shots.action: K Tomíkovi přijede robot Bip, zabliká anténkou a na obrazovce se mu objeví úsměv.
shots.keyframe: Bip the robot rolls up to Tommy in the school hallway, its antenna light blinking
shots.motion: the robot rolls up to Tommy, its red antenna light blinks and its screen shows a smile
shots.narration: Vtom přijel robot Bip a zablikal.
shots.narration_en: Then Bip the robot rolled up and blinked.

shots.action: Bip ukáže ručkou do chodby. Tomík kývne a vydá se za ním.
shots.keyframe: Bip the robot points down the school hallway with its stubby arm, Tommy looks where it points
shots.motion: the robot points down the hallway, Tommy nods and starts walking after it

shots.action: Tomík a Bip jdou vedle sebe slunnou chodbou. Tomík se trochu usmívá.
shots.keyframe: Tommy and Bip the robot walk together down the sunny school hallway
shots.motion: Tommy and the robot move down the hallway side by side, Tommy smiles a little
shots.narration: Šli spolu chodbou až ke třídě.
shots.narration_en: Together they went down the hall to class.

shots.action: Ve třídě si Tomík sedne do lavice, sundá batoh a podívá se na holčičku s červenými copánky. Anička mu zamává a on nesměle zamává zpátky.
shots.keyframe: Tommy sits at a school desk in a colorful classroom next to a smiling girl with red pigtails
motion: Tommy sits down at the desk, takes off his backpack and looks at the girl next to him
the girl smiles and waves at Tommy, Tommy waves back shyly
shots.narration: Ve třídě si sedl vedle Aničky. Anička mu zamávala.
shots.narration_en: In class he sat next to Annie. Annie waved hello.

shots.action: O přestávce nabídne Tomík Aničce jablíčka ze svačiny. Vezme si a oba se smějí.
shots.keyframe: Tommy shares apple slices from his lunchbox with the girl with red pigtails at the school desk
shots.motion: Tommy holds out his lunchbox with apple slices, the girl takes one and they both laugh
shots.narration: O přestávce se rozdělili o jablíčko.
shots.narration_en: At break they shared his apple slices.

shots.action: Na slunném dvoře tančí Tomík robotí tanec: trhané, strojové pohyby rukama.
shots.keyframe: Tommy stands in the sunny schoolyard, smiling
shots.motion: Tommy dances the robot dance on the spot, moving his arms in stiff sharp steps like a robot, same green hoodie, same schoolyard
shots.narration: Na dvoře Tomík tančil jako robot.
shots.narration_en: In the yard, Tommy danced like a robot.

shots.action: Bip se radostí zatočí na kolečku a anténka bliká. Tomík tleská a směje se.
shots.keyframe: Bip the robot spins around happily in the schoolyard next to laughing Tommy
shots.motion: the robot spins around once on its wheel, its antenna blinks, Tommy claps and laughs
shots.narration: Bip se točil a všichni se smáli.
shots.narration_en: Bip spun around and everyone laughed.

shots.action: Odpoledne vycházejí Tomík s Aničkou ze školní brány, houpají rukama a mávají škole na rozloučenou.
shots.keyframe: Tommy and the girl with red pigtails walk out of the school gate in the afternoon sun, waving
shots.motion: Tommy and the girl walk out of the gate swinging their arms and wave goodbye to the school
shots.narration: Domů už šel s novou kamarádkou.
shots.narration_en: He walked home with a new friend.

shots.action: Večer u psacího stolu dokreslí Tomík obrázek robota, zvedne ho a hrdě se usměje.
shots.keyframe: Tommy sits at his desk in his bedroom in the evening, drawing a picture of a small round white robot
shots.motion: Tommy finishes the drawing of the robot, holds up the picture and smiles proudly
shots.narration: Večer nakreslil Bipa. Zítra půjde rád.
shots.narration_en: That evening he drew Bip, happy for tomorrow.
